A book is primarily made of paper, which is typically bound together with a cover and held by a spine.

Abigail gripped the handrail of the cruise liner as it glided smoothly across the Pacific towards the new world. It was 2024, and she was leaving behind the stifling constraints of her traditional life in a small English village for the promise of independence and adventure in America. She clutched her small, battered carry-on that contained all her worldly possessions, her heart racing with both fear and excitement.
